description: In combination with `histSST`, quantifies the transient effective radiative forcing (ERF) from historical changes in desert dust over the historical period. Same as `histSST`, except dust follows the historical dust emission dataset of Leung et al. (2025), which captures the observed increase in dust since pre-industrial times. Atmosphere-only counterpart of `hist-Dust`.
branch_information: Branch from `piControl` at a time of your choosing
